conclusion: In this work, we introduce SmolDocling, an efficient and compact VLM optimized for document conversion while providing rich output representation. We also present a suite of new datasets with a unified format for document conversion, including the novel task of code listing transcription. We identify page element localization as a critical area requiring further refinement, where targeted techniques will significantly enhance performance in future iterations. Our results conclusively demonstrate that smaller models with unified, optimized output formats such as DocTags can effectively compete with significantly larger models, establishing a clear pathway for resource-efficient multi-task document understanding models.
